translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
Alif-Laam-Meem
yeh kitab aesi hai kay iss mein koi shak nahi ,   yeh hidayat hai unn darr rakhney walon kay liye
jo bey dekhi cheezon per emaan latay hain ,   aur namaz qaeem kertay hain , aur jo kuch hum ney unhen diya hai uss mein say ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay kamon mein ) kharch kertay hain
aur jo uss ( wahi ) per bhi emaan latay hain jo aap per utaari gaee aur uss per bhi jo aap say pehlay utaari gaee ,   aur aakhirat per woh mukammal yaqeen rakhtay hain
yeh hain woh log jo apney perwerdigar ki taraf say sahih raastay per hain , aur yehi woh log hain jo falah paaney walay hain
beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr apna liya hai ,   unn kay haq mein dono baaten barabar hain , chahye aap unn ko darayen , ya naa darayen ,   woh emaan nahi layen gay
Allah ney unn kay dilon per aur unn kay kanon per mohar lagadi hai ,   aur unn ki aankhon per perda parra huwa hai , aur unn kay liye zabardast azab hai
kuch log woh hain jo kehtay hain kay hum Allah per aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan ley aaye , halankay woh ( haqeeqat mein ) momin nahi hain

woh Allah ko aur unn logon  ko jo ( waqaee ) emaan laa-chukay hain dhoka detay hain . aur ( haqeeqat to yeh hai kay ) woh apney siwa kissi aur ko dhoka nahi dey rahey , lekin unhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai
inn kay dilon mein rog hai , chunacheh Allah ney inn kay rog mein aur izafa kerdiya hai ,   aur inn kay liye dardnak saza tayyar hai , kiyonkay woh jhoot bola kertay thay
aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay tum zameen mein fasad naa machao to woh kehtay hain kay hum to islaah kernay walay hain
yaad rakho ! yehi log fasad phelaney walay hain , lekin enhen iss baat ka ehsas nahi hai

aur jab inn say kaha jata hai kay tum bhi ussi tarah emaan ley aao jaisay doosray log emaan laye hain to woh kehtay hain kay kiya hum bhi ussi tarah emaan layen jaisay beywaqoof log emaan laye hain-? khoob achi tarah sunn lo kay yehi log bey waqoof hain , lekin woh yeh baat nahi jantay

aur jab yeh unn logon  say miltay hain jo emaan laa-chukay hain to kehtay hain kay hum emaan ley aaye , aur jab yeh apney shetanon   kay paas tanhai mein jatay hain to kehtay hain kay hum tumharay sath hain , hum to mazaq ker-rahey thay
Allah unn say mazaq ( ka moamla ) kerta hai aur unhen aesi dheel deta hai kay woh apni sarkashi mein bhataktay rahen
yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi khareed li hai , lehaza naa unn ki tijarat mein nafaa huwa , aur naa unhen sahih raasta naseeb huwa

unn ki misal uss shaks ki si hai jiss ney aik aag roshan ki ,   phir jab uss ( aag ney ) uss kay mahol ko roshan kerdiya to Allah ney unn ka noor salb kerliya aur unhen andheriyon mein chorr diya kay unhen kuch sujhai nahi deta
woh behray hain , goongay hain , andhay hain , chunacheh abb woh wapis nahi ayen gay

ya phir ( inn munafiqon ki misal aesi hai )   jaisay aasman say barasti aik barish ho , jiss mein andheriyan bhi hon , aur garaj bhi aur chamak bhi . woh karrkon ki aawaz per moat kay khof say apni ungliyan apney kanon mein dey letay hain . aur Allah ney kafiron ko gheray mein   ley rakha hai

aisa lagta hai kay bijli unn ki aankhon ko uchak ley jaye gi . jab bhi bijli unn kay liye roshni ker-deti hai , woh uss ( roshni ) mein chal parrtay hain , aur jab woh unn per andhera ker-deti hai to kharray reh jatay hain , aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay sunney aur dekhney ki taqaten cheen leta , beyshak Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai
aey logo ! apney uss perwerdigar ki ibadat kero jiss ney tumhen aur unn logon  ko peda kiya jo tum say pehlay guzray hain , takay tum muttaqi ban jao

. ( woh perwerdigar ) jiss ney tumharay liye zameen ko bichona banaya , aur aasman ko chhat aur aasman say paani barsaya , phir iss kay zariye tumharay rizq kay tor per phal nikalay , lehaza Allah kay sath shareek naa thehrao , jabkay tum ( yeh sabb baaten ) jantay ho

aur agar tum iss( Quran ) kay baaray mein zara bhi shak mein ho jo hum ney apney banday Muhammad ( SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam ) per utaara hai , to iss jaisi koi aik surat hi bana lao , aur agar sachay ho to Allah kay siwa apney tamam madad gaaron ko bulalo
phir bhi agar tum yeh kaam naa ker-sako , aur yaqeenan kabhi nahi ker-sako gay , to daro uss aag say jiss ka endhan insan aur pathar hon gay , woh kafiron kay liye tayyar ki gaee hai .

aur jo log emaan laye hain , aur unhon ney naik amal kiye hain , unn ko khushkhabri dey do kay unn kay liye aesay baaghaat ( tayyar ) hain jinn kay neechay nehren behti hon gi ,   jab kabhi unn ko unn ( baaghaat ) mein say koi phal rizq kay tor per diya jaye ga , to woh kahen gay " yeh to wohi hai jo hamen pehlay bhi diya gaya tha   aur unhen woh rizq aisa hi diya jaye ga jo dekhney mein milta julta hoga ,   aur unn kay liye wahan pakeezah biwiyan hon gi , aur woh unn ( baaghaat ) mein hamesha hamesha rahen gay

beyshak Allah iss baat say nahi sharmata kay woh ( kissi baat ko wazeh kernay kay liye ) koi bhi misal dey , chahye woh machar ( jaisi mamooli cheez ) ki ho , ya kissi aesi cheez ki jo machar say bhi ziyada ( mamooli ) ho ,   abb jo log momin hain woh khoob jantay hain kay yeh misal aik haq baat hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai . albatta jo log kafir hain woh yehi kehtay hain kay bhala iss ( haqeer ) misal say Allah ka kiya matlab hai-? ( iss tarah ) Allah iss misal say boht say logon  ko gumrahi mein mubtala kerta hai , aur boht so ko hidayat deta hai . ( magar ) woh gumrah unhi ko kerta hai jo nafarman hain

woh jo Allah say kiye huye ehad ko pukhta kernay kay baad bhi torr detay hain ,   aur jinn rishton ko Allah ney jorrney ka hukum diya hai , unhen kaat daaltay hain aur zameen mein fasad machatay hain ,   aesay hi log bara nuqsan uthaney walay hain

tum Allah kay sath kufr ka tarz-e-amal aakhir kaisay ikhtiyar kerletay ho , halankay tum bey jaan thay , ussi ney tumhen zindagi bakhshi , phir wohi tumhen moat dey ga , phir wohi tum ko ( dobara ) zinda keray ga , aur phir tum ussi kay paas lot ker jao gay

wohi hai jiss ney zameen mein jo kuch hai tumharay liye peda kiya ,   phir woh aasman ki taraf mutawajjah huwa , chunacheh unn ko saat aasmano ki shakal mein theek theek banadiya , aur woh her cheez ka poora ilm rakhney wala hai

aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab tumharay perwerdigar ney farishton say kaha kay mein zameen mein aik khalifa bananey wala hun ,   woh kehney lagay :  kiya aap zameen mein aesi makhlooq peda keren gay jo uss mein fasad machaye , aur khoon kharaba keray , halankay hum aap ki tasbeeh aur hamd o taqdees mein lagay huye hain ?    Allah ney kaha :  mein woh baaten janta hun jo tum nahi jantay
aur Adam ko ( Allah ney ) saray kay saray naam sikha-diye ,   phir unn ko farishton kay samney paish kiya aur ( unn say ) kaha :  agar tum sachay ho to mujhay inn cheezon kay naam to batlao
woh bol uthay : aap hi ki zaat pak hai , jo kuch ilm aap ney hamen diya hai uss kay siwa hum kuch nahi jantay .   haqeeqat mein ilm o hikmat kay malik to sirf aap hain

Allah ney kaha :  Adam ! tum inn ko inn cheezon kay naam batado  chunacheh jab uss ney unn kay naam unn ko batadiye to Allah ney ( farishton say ) kaha :  kiya mein ney tum say nahi kaha tha kay mein aasmano aur zameen kay bhed janta hun-? aur jo kuch tum zahir kertay ho aur jo kuch tum chupatay ho mujhay uss sabb ka ilm hai

aur ( uss waqt ka tazkarah suno ) jab hum ney farishton say kaha kay :  Adam ko sajda kero ,   chunacheh sabb ney sajda kiya , siwaye iblees kay kay uss ney inkar kiya ,   aur mutakabbirana ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya aur kafiron mein shamil hogaya

aur hum ney kaha :  Adam ! tum aur tumhari biwi jannat mein raho , aur uss mein say jahan say chahao ji bhar kay khao , magar iss darkht kay paas bhi matt jana ,   werna tum zalimon mein shumar hogay .

phir huwa yeh kay shetan ney unn dono ko wahan say dagmaga diya , aur jiss ( aesh ) mein woh thay uss say unhen nikal ker raha   aur hum ney ( Adam , unn ki biwi aur iblees say ) kaha :  abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao , tum aik doosray kay dushman hogay , aur tumharay liye aik mauddat tak zameen mein thehrna aur kissi qadar faeeda uthana ( tey kerdiya gaya ) hai

phir Adam ney apney perwerdigar say ( tauba kay ) kuch alfaz seekh liye ( jinn kay zariye unhon ney tauba maangi ) chunacheh Allah ney unn ki tauba qubool kerli .   beyshak woh boht moaaf kernay wala , bara meharban hai

hum ney :  kaha abb tum sabb yahan say utar jao . phir agar meri taraf say koi hidayat tumhen phonchay , to jo log meri hidayat ki perwi keren gay , unn ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .
aur jo log kufr ka irtikab keren gay aur humari aayaton ko jhutlayen gay woh dozakh walay log hain jahan woh hamesha rahen gay .

aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur tum mujh say kiya huwa ehad poora karo , takay mein bhi tum say kiya huwa ehad poora karun , aur tum ( kissi aur say nahi , balkay ) sirf mujhi say daro

aur jo kalam mein ney nazil kiya hai uss per emaan lao , jabkay woh uss kitab ( yani toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi ker-raha hai jo tumharay paas hai , aur tum hi sabb say pehlay iss kay munkir naa ban jao . aur meri aayaton ko mamooli si qeemat ley ker naa becho , aur ( kissi aur kay bajaye ) sirf mera khof dil mein rakho
aur haq ko batil kay sath gaddmadd naa kero , aur naa haq baat ko chupao jabkay ( asal haqeeqat ) tum achi tarah jantay ho
aur namaz qaeem karo , aur zakat ada karo , aur rukoo kernay walon kay sath rukoo karo
kiya tum ( doosray ) logon  ko to naiki ka hukum detay ho , aur khud apney aap ko bhool jatay ho-? halankay tum kitab ki tilawat bhi kertay ho ! kiya tumhen itni bhi samajh nahi-?
aur sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero . namaz bhari zaroor maloom hoti hai , magar unn logon  ko nahi jo khushoo ( yani dhiyan aur aajzi ) say parhtay hain
jo iss baat ka khayal rakhtay hain kay woh apney perwerdigar say milney walay hain , aur unn ko ussi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad karo jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi

aur uss din say daro , jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say koi sifarish qubool ki jaye gi , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya liya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi

aur woh ( waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum ko firon kay logon  say najat di jo tumhen bara azab detay thay , tumharay beton ko zabah ker daaltay aur tumhari aurton ko zinda rakhtay thay .   aur iss sari soorat-e-haal mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say tumhara bara imtihan tha .

aur ( yaad karo ) jab hum ney tumhari khatir samandar ko phaarr daala tha , chunacheh tum sabb ko bachaliya tha aur firon kay logon  ko ( samandar mein ) gharq ker daala tha   aur tum yeh sara nazara dekh rahey thay
aur ( woh waqt yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa say chaalees raaton ka wada thehraya tha , phir tum ney unn kay peechay ( apni janon per ) zulm kerkay bachrray ko mabood bana-liya
phir iss sabb kay baad bhi hum ney tum ko moaaf kerdiya takay tum shukar ada karo
aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur haq o batil mein tameez ka mayaar ( bakhsha ) takay tum raah-e-raast per aao

aur jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay " aey meri qoam ! haqeeqat mein tum ney bachrray ko mabood bana ker khud apni janon per zulm kiya hai , lehaza abb apney khaliq say tauba karo aur apney aap ko qatal kero . tumharay khaliq kay nazdeek yehi tumharay haq mein behtar hai .  iss tarah Allah ney tumhari tauba qubool kerli . bey shak wohi hai jo itna moaaf kernay wala , itna reham kernay wala hai

aur jab tum ney kaha tha ! aey musa hum uss waqt tak hergiz tumhara yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak Allah ko hum khud khuli aankhon naa dekh len  nateeja yeh huwa kay karrkay ney tumhen iss tarah aa pakra kay tum dekhtay reh gaye
phir hum ney tumhen tumharay marney kay baad doosri zindagi di takay tum shukar guzaar bano

aur hum ney tum ko badal ka saya ata kiya , aur tum per mann-o-salwa nazil kiya ( aur kaha kay : ) jo pakeezah rizq hum ney tumhen bakhsha hai ( shoq say ) khao   aur yeh ( nafarmaniyan kerkay ) unhon ney humara kuch nahi bigaara , balkay woh khud apni janon per hi zulm kertay rahey

aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab hum ney kaha tha kay : "" iss basti mein dakhil hojao aur iss mein jahan say chahao ji bhar ker khao , aur ( basti kay ) darwazay mein jhukay saron kay sath dakhil hona , aur yeh kehtay jana kay ( ya-Allah ! ) hum aap ki bakhshish kay talab gaar hain , ( iss tarah ) hum tumhari khatayen moaaf kerden gay , aur naiki kernay walon ko aur ziyada ( sawab ) bhi den gay .

magar huwa yeh kay jo baat unn say kahi gaee thi , zalimon ney ussay badal ker aik aur baat banali .   nateeja yeh kay jo nafarmaniyan woh kertay aarahey thay hum ney unn ki saza mein unn zalimon per aasman say azab nazil kiya

aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam kay liye paani maanga to hum ney kaha :  apni laathi pathar per maaro   chunacheh iss ( pathar ) say baara chashmay phoot niklay .   her aik qabeelay ney apney paani lenay ki jagah maloom kerli . ( hum ney kaha : ) Allah ka diya huwa rizq khao piyo , aur zameen mein fasad machatay matt phirna .

aur ( woh waqt bhi ) jab tum ney kaha tha kay aey musa ! hum aik hi khaney per sabar nahi ker-saktay , lehaza humari khatir apney perwerdigar say maangiye kay woh humaray liye kuch woh cheezen peda keray jo zameen ugaya kerti hai , yani zameen ki tarkariyan , uss ki kakriyan , uss ka gandum , uss ki daalen aur uss ki piyaz . musa ney kaha : " jo ( ghiza ) behtar thi kiya tum uss ko aesi cheezon say badalna chahtay ho jo ghatiya darjay ki hain-? ( khair ! ) aik shehar mein jaa utro , to wahan tumhen woh cheezen mil jayen gi jo tum ney maangi hain .    aur unn ( yahudiyon ) per zillat aur beykasi ka thappa lagadiya gaya , aur woh Allah ka ghazab ley ker lotay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay woh Allah ki aayaton ka inkar kertay thay aur payghumberon ko nahaq qatal ker-detay thay . yeh sabb iss liye huwa kay unhon ney nafarmani ki , aur woh beyhad ziyadtiyan kertay thay .

haq to yeh hai kay jo log bhi , khuwa woh musalman hon ya yahudi ya nasrani ya saabi , Allah aur aakhirat kay din per emaan ley ayen gay aur naik amal keren gay , woh apney perwerdigar kay paas apney ajar kay mustahiq hon gay , aur unn ko naa koi khof hoga , naa woh kissi ghum mein mubtala hon gay .

aur wo waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ( toraat per amal kernay ka ) ehad liya tha , aur koh-e-toor ko tumharay oopper utha kharra kiya tha ( kay ) jo ( kitab ) hum ney tumhen di hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo ,   aur uss mein jo kuch ( likha ) hai uss ko yaad rakho , takay tumhen taqwa hasil ho
iss sabb kay bawajood tum dobara ( raah-e-raast say ) phir gaye . chunacheh agar Allah ka fazal aur rehmat tum per naa hoti to tum zaroor sakht nuqsan uthaney walon mein shamil hojatay .
aur tum apney unn logon  ko achi tarah jantay ho jo saneechar ( sabt ) kay moamlay mein hadd say guzar gaye thay , chunacheh hum ney unn say kaha tha kay tum dhutkaray huye bandar ban jao
phir hum ney iss waqaey ko uss zamaney kay aur uss kay baad kay logon  kay liye ibrat , aur darney walon kay liye naseehat ka saman banadiya

aur ( wo waqt yaad kero ) jab musa ney apni qoam say kaha tha kay Allah tumhen hukum deta hai kay tum aik gaye zibah kero . woh kehney lagay kay kiya aap humara mazaq banatay hain-?   musa ney kaha : mein iss baat say Allah ki panah maangta hun kay mein ( aesay ) nadanon mein shamil hun ( jo mazaq mein jhoot bolen )

unhon ney kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? uss ney kaha :  Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho kay naa boht boorhi ho naa bilkul bachi , ( balkay ) inn dono kay bech bech mein ho . bus abb jo hukum tumhen diya gaya hai uss per amal kerlo .

kehney lagay : aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay uss ka rang kaisa ho-? musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesay tez zard rang ki gaye ho jo dekhney walon ka dil khush kerday .

unhon ney ( phir ) kaha kay aap humari khatir apney rab say darkhuwast kijiye kay hamen saaf saaf bataye kay woh gaye kaisi ho-? iss gaye ney to hamen shubhay mein daal diya hai . aur Allah ney chaha to hum zaroor iss ka pata lagalen gay .

musa ney kaha : Allah farmata hai kay woh aesi gaye ho jo kaam mein jutt ker zameen naa gahati ho , aur naa kheti ko paani deti ho , poori tarah sahih saalim ho jiss mein koi dagh naa ho . unhon ney kaha : haan ! abb aap theek theek pata ley ker aaye . iss kay baad unhon ney ussay zibah kiya , jabkay lagta nahi tha kay woh ker payen gay .
aur ( yaad karo ) jab tum ney aik shaks ko qatal kerdiya tha , aur uss kay baad uss ka ilzam aik doosray per daal rahey thay , aur Allah ko woh raaz nikal bahir kerna tha jo tum chupaye huye thay .

chunacheh hum ney kaha kay uss ( maqtool ) ko uss ( gaye ) kay aik hissay say maaro .   issi tarah Allah murdon ko zinda kerta hai , aur tumhen ( apni qudrat ki ) nishaniyan dikhata hai takay tum samajh sako .

iss sabb kay baad tumharay dil phir sakht hogaye , yahan tak kay woh aesay hogaye jaisay pathar ! balkay sakhti mein kuch unn say bhi ziyada . ( kiyonkay ) pathraon mein say kuch aesay bhi hotay hain jinn say nehren phoot behti hain , aur unhi mein say kuch woh hotay hain jo khud phatt parrtay hain aur unn say paani nikal aata hai , aur unhi mein woh ( pathar ) bhi hain jo Allah kay khof say lurhak jatay hain .   . aur ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo kuch tum ker rahey ho , Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

. ( musalmano ! ) kiya abb bhi tumhen yeh lalach hai kay yeh log tumharay kehney say emaan ley ayen gay-? halankay inn mein say aik giroh kay log Allah ka kalam suntay thay , phir uss ko achi tarah samajhney kay baad bhi jantay boojhtay uss mein tehreef kar daaltay thay .

aur jab yeh log inn ( musalmanon ) say miltay hain jo pehlay emaan laa-chukay hain to ( zaban say ) keh detay hain kay hum ( bhi ) emaan ley aaye hain , aur jab yeh aik doosray kay sath tanhai mein jatay hain to ( aapas mein aik doosray say ) kehtay hain kay :  kiya tum inn ( musalmanon ) ko woh baaten batatay ho jo Allah taalaa ney tum per kholi hain takay yeh ( musalman ) tumharay perwerdigar kay paas jaker enhe tumharay khilaf daleel kay tor per paish keren-?   kiya tumhen itni bhi aqal nahi ?
kiya yeh log ( jo aesi baaten kertay hain ) yeh nahi jantay kay Allah ko unn sari baaton ka khoob ilm hai , jo woh chupatay hain aur jo woh zahir kertay hain ?
aur inn mein say kuch log ann parh hain jo kitab ( toraat ) ka ilm to rakhtay nahi , albatta kuch aarzooyen pakaye bethay hain , aur unn ka kaam bus yeh hai kay weham o gumaan baandhtay rehtay hain .

lehaza tabahi hai unn logon  ki jo apney haathon say kitab likhtay hain , phir ( logon  say ) kehtay hain kay yeh Allah ki taraf say hai , takay uss kay zariye thori si aamdani kama len .   pus tabahi hai unn logon  per uss tehreer ki wajeh say bhi jo unn kay haathon ney likhi , aur tabahi hai unn per uss aamdani ki wajeh say bhi jo woh kamatay hain .

aur yahudiyon ney kaha hai kay hamen ginti kay chand dino kay ilawa aag hergiz nahi chooye gi . aap unn say kahiye kay kiya tum ney Allah ki taraf say koi ehad ley rakha hai jiss ki bana per woh apney ehad ki khilaf warzi nahi ker-sakta , ya tum Allah kay zimmay woh baat laga rahey ho jiss ka tumhen kuch pata nahi-?
. ( aag tumhen ) kiyon nahi ( chooye gi ) ? jo log bhi badi kamatay hain aur unn ki badi unhen gher leti hai   to aesay log hi dozakh kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .
aur jo log emaan latay hain aur naik amal kertay hain , to woh jannat kay baasi hain . woh hamesha uss mein rahen gay .

aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab hum ney bani Israel say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum Allah kay siwa kissi ki ibadat nahi kero gay , aur walaiden say acha sulook karo gay , aur rishta daaron say bhi aur yateemon aur miskeeno say bhi . aur logon  say bhali baat kehna , aur namaz qaeem kerna aur zakat dena .  ( magar ) phir tum mein say thoray say logon  kay siwa baqi sabb ( uss ehad say ) mun morr ker phir gaye .

aur ( yaad kero ) jab hum ney tum say paka ehad liya tha kay :  tum aik doosray ka khoon nahi bahao gay , aur apney aadmiyon ko apney gharon say nahi nikalo gay  phir tum ney iqrar kiya tha , aur tum khud uss kay gawah ho .

uss kay baad ( aaj ) tum hi woh log ho kay apney hi aadmiyon ko qatal kertay ho , aur apney hi mein say kuch logon  ko unn kay gharon say nikal bahir kertay ho , aur unn kay khilaf gunah aur ziyadti ka irtikab ker kay ( unn kay dushmanon ki ) madad kertay ho , aur agar woh ( dushmanon kay ) qedi ban ker tumharay paas aajatay hain to tum unn ko fidya dey ker churra letay ho , halankay unn ko ( ghar say ) nikalna hi tumharay liye haram tha .   to kiya tum kitab ( toraat ) kay kuch hissay per to emaan rakhtay ho aur kuch ka inkar kertay ho-? abb batao kay jo shaks aisa keray uss ki saza iss kay siwa kiya hai kay dunyawi zindagi mein uss ki ruswai ho-? aur qayamat kay din aesay logon  ko sakht tareen azab ki taraf bhej diya jaye ga . aur jo kuch tum amal kertay ho Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .
yeh woh log hain jinhon ney dunyawi zindagi ko aakhirat kay badlay khareed liya hai , lehaza naa unn kay azab mein koi takhfeef hogi aur naa unn ki madad ki jayegi .

aur beyshak hum ney musa ko kitab di , aur uss kay baad pey-dar-pay Rasool bhejay . aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki taeed ki .   phir yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay jab kabhi koi Rasool tumharay paas koi aesi baat ley ker aaya jo tumhari nafsani khuwaishaat ko pasand nahi thi to tum akarr gaye ? chunacheh baaz ( anbiya ) ko tum ney jhutlaya , aur baaz ko qatal kertay rahey .
aur yeh log kehtay hain kay :  humaray dil ghilaf mein hain .   nahi ! balkay unn kay kufr ki wajeh say Allah ney unn per phitkaar daal rakhi hai , iss liye woh kam hi emaan latay hain .

aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say woh kitab aai ( yani Quran ) jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hai jo pehlay say unn kay paas hai , ( to unn ka tarz-e-amal dekho ! ) bawajood-yeh-kay yeh khud shuroo mein kafiron ( yani butt paraston ) kay khilaf ( iss kitab kay hawalay say ) Allah say fatah ki duayen maanga kertay thay ,   magar jab woh cheez unn kay paas aagae jissay unhon ney pehchan bhi liya , to uss ka inkar ker bethay . pus phitkaar hai Allah ki aesay kafiron per !

buri hai woh qeemat jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janon ko bech daala hai , kay yeh Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ka sirf iss jalan ki bana per inkar ker rahey hain kay Allah apney fazal ka koi hissa ( yani wahi ) apney bandon mein say jiss per chah raha hai ( kiyon ) utaar raha hai ? chunacheh yeh ( apni iss/uss jalan ki wajeh say ) ghazab balaye ghazab ley ker lotay hain .   aur kafir log zillat aamez saza kay mustahiq hain .

aur jab unn say kaha jata hai kay Allah ney jo kalam utaara hai uss per emaan ley aao , to woh kehtay hain kay hum to ( sirf ) ussi kalam per emaan rakhen gay jo hum per nazil kiya gaya , ( yani toraat ) aur woh uss kay siwa ( doosri aasmani kitabon ) ka inkar kertay hain , halankay woh bhi haq hain , ( aur ) jo kitab unn kay paas hai woh uss ki tasdeeq bhi kerti hain . ( aey payghumber ! ) tum inn say kaho kay agar tum waqaee ( toraat per ) emaan rakhtay thay to Allah kay nabiyon ko pehlay zamaney mein kiyon qatal kertay rahey-?
aur khud musa tumharay paas roshan nishaniyan ley ker aaye , phir tum ney unn kay peeth peechay yeh sitam dhaaya kay gaye kay bachrray ko mabood bana liya .

aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney tum say ehad liya aur tumharay oopper toor ko buland kerdiya ( aur yeh kaha kay )  jo kuch hum ney tum ko diya hai uss ko mazbooti say thaamo   aur ( jo kuch kaha jaye ussay hosh say ) suno  . kehney lagay :  hum ney ( pehlay bhi ) sunn liya tha , magar amal nahi kiya tha ( abb bhi aisa hi keren gay )  aur ( darasal ) unn kay kufr ki nahoosat say unn kay dilon mein bachrra basa huwa tha . aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay agar tum momin ho to kitni buri hain woh baaten jo tumhara emaan tumhen talqeen ker raha hai !

aap ( unn say ) kahiye kay :  agar Allah kay nazdeek aakhirat ka ghar tamam insanon ko chorr ker sirf tumharay hi liye makhsoos hai ( jaisa kay tumhara kehna hai ) to moat ki tamanna to ker kay dikhao , agar waqaee sachay ho
aur ( hum bataye detay hain kay ) unhon ney apney jo kartoot aagay bhej rakhay hain , unn ki wajeh say yeh kabhi aesi tamanna nahi keren gay .   Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

. ( balkay ) yaqeenan tum unn logon  ko pao gay kay unhen zinda rehney ki hirs doosray tamam insanon say ziyada hai , yahan tak kay mushrikeen say bhi ziyada . inn mein ka aik aik shaks yeh chahta hai kay aik hazar saal umar paye , halankay kissi ka bari umar paalena ussay azab say door nahi ker-sakta . aur yeh jo amal bhi kertay hain Allah ussay achi tarah dekh raha hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) keh do kay agar koi shaks jibraeel ka dushman hai   to ( huwa keray ) unhon ney to yeh kalam Allah ki ijazat say tumharay dil per utaara hai jo apney say pehlay ki kitabon ki tasdeeq ker raha hai , aur emaan walon kay liye mujassam hidayat aur khushkhabri hai .
agar koi shaks Allah ka , uss kay farishton aur Rasoolon ka , aur jibraeel aur mekael ka dushman hai to ( woh sunn rakhay kay ) Allah kafiron ka dushman hai .
aur beyshak hum ney aap per aesi aayaten utaari hain jo haq ko aashkaar kernay wali hain , aur unn ka inkar wohi log kertay hain jo nafarman hain .
yeh aakhir kiya moamla hai kay inn logon  ney jab koi ehad kiya , inn kay aik giroh ney ussay hamesha torr phenka-? balkay unn mein say aksar log emaan latay hi nahi .

aur jab unn kay paas Allah ki taraf say aik Rasool aaye jo uss ( toraat ) ki tasdeeq ker rahey thay jo inn kay paas hai , to ehal-e-kitab mein say aik giroh ney Allah ki kitab ( toraat o injeel ) ko iss tarah pus-e-pusht daal diya goya woh kuch jantay hi naa thay ( kay uss mein nabi aakhir-uz-zaman SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam kay baaray mein kiya hidayaat di gaee then )

aur yeh ( bani Israel ) unn ( mantaron ) kay peechay lagg gaye jo suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ki saltanat kay zamaney mein shayateen parha kertay thay . aur suleman ( aleh-assalam ) ney koi kufr nahi kiya tha , albatta shayateen logon  ko jadoo ki taleem dey ker kufr ka irtikab kertay thay .   neez ( yeh bani Israel ) uss cheez kay peechay lagg gaye jo shehar babil mein haroot aur maaroot naami do farishton per nazil ki gaee thi .   yeh do farishtay kissi ko uss waqt tak koi taleem nahi detay thay jab tak uss say yeh naa keh den kay :  hum mehaz aazmaesh kay liye ( bhejay gaye ) hain , lehaza tum ( jadoo kay peechay lagg ker ) kufr ikhtiyar naa kerna .  phir bhi yeh log unn say woh cheezen seekhtay thay jiss kay zariye mard aur uss ki biwi mein judai peda kerden . ( wesay yeh wazeh rahey kay ) woh uss kay zariye kissi ko Allah ki mashiyat kay baghair koi nuqsan nahi phoncha saktay thay .   ( magar ) woh aesi baaten seekhtay thay jo unn kay liye nuqsan deh then , aur faeeda mand naa then . aur woh yeh bhi khoob jantay thay kay jo shaks inn cheezon ka khareedaar banay ga , aakhirat mein uss ka koi hissa nahi hoga . aur haqeeqat yeh hai kay woh cheez boht buri thi jiss kay badlay unhon ney apni janen bech daalen . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
aur ( iss kay bar-aks ) agar woh emaan aur taqwa ikhtiyar kertay to Allah kay paas say milney wala sawab yaqeenan kahen ziyada behtar hota . kaash kay unn ko ( iss baat ka bhi haqeeqi ) ilm hota .
emaan walo ! ( Rasool Allah SallAllaho-alehi-wa-aalihi-wasallam say mukhatib hoker ) raeena naa kaha karo , aur unzurna keh diya kero .   aur suna kero . aur kafiron kay liye dardnak azab hai .

kafir log khuwa ehal-e-kitab mein say hon ya mushrikeen mein say , yeh pasand nahi kertay kay tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say koi bhalai tum per nazil ho , halankay Allah jiss ko chahta hai apni rehmat kay liye makhsoos farma leta hai . aur Allah fazal-e-azeem ka malik hai .

hum jab bhi koi aayat mansookh kertay hain ya ussay bhula detay hain to uss say behtar ya ussi jaisi ( aayat ) ley aatay hain .   kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah her cheez per qudrat rakhta hai-?
kiya tumhen yeh maloom nahi kay Allah woh zaat hai kay aasmano aur zameen ki saltanat tanha ussi ki hai , aur Allah kay siwa naa koi tumhara rakhwala hai naa madadgaar-?

kiya tum yeh chahtay ho kay apney Rasool say ussi qisam kay sawal kero jaisay pehlay musa say kiye ja-chukay hain-?   aur jo shaks emaan kay badlay kufr ikhtiyar keray woh yaqeenan seedhay raastay say bhatak gaya .

. ( musalmano ) boht say ehal-e-kitab apney dilon kay hasad ki bana per yeh chahtay hain kay tumharay emaan laney kay baad tumhen palta ker phir kafir bana den , bawajood-yeh-kay haq unn per wazeh hochuka hai . chunacheh tum moaaf kero aur darguzar say kaam lo yahan tak kay Allah khud apna faisla bhej dey . beyshak Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

aur namaz qaeem kero aur zakat ada kero , aur ( yaad rakho kay ) jo bhalai ka amal bhi tum khud apney faeeday kay liye aagay bhej do gay uss ko Allah kay paas pao gay . beyshak jo amal bhi tum kertay ho Allah ussay dekh raha hai .

aur yeh ( yani yahudi aur essai ) kehtay hain kay :  jannat mein siwaye yahudiyon ya essaiyon kay koi bhi hergiz dakhil nahi hoga .    yeh mehaz inn ki aarzooyen hain . aap inn say kahiye kay agar tum ( apney iss daway mein ) sachay ho to apni koi daleel ley ker aao .

kiyon nahi-? ( qaeeda yeh hai kay ) jo shaks bhi apna rukh Allah kay aagay jhuka dey , aur woh naik amal kernay wala ho , ussay apna ajar apney perwerdigar kay paas milay ga . aur aesay logon  ko naa koi khof hoga , aur naa woh ghumgeen hon gay .

aur yahudi kehtay hain kay essaiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , aur essai kehtay hain kay yahudiyon ( kay mazahab ) ki koi buniyad nahi , halankay yeh sabb ( aasmani ) kitab parhtay hain . issi tarah woh ( mushrikeen ) jinn kay paas koi ( aasmani ) ilm hi siray say nahi hai , unhon ney bhi inn ( ehal-e-kitab ) ki jaisi baaten kehni shuroo kerdi hain . chunacheh Allah hi qayamat kay din inn kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray ga jinn mein yeh ikhtilaf kertay rahey hain .

aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo Allah ki masjidon per iss baat ki bandish laga dey kay unn mein Allah ka naam liya jaye , aur unn ko weeran kernay ki koshish keray . aesay logon  ko yeh haq nahi phonchta kay woh unn ( masjidon ) mein dakhil hon magar dartay huye .   aesay logon  kay liye duniya mein ruswai hai aur unhi ko aakhirat mein zabardast azab hoga .
aur mashriq o maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . lehaza jiss taraf bhi tum rukh karo gay , wahin Allah ka rukh hai .   beyshak Allah boht wusat wala , bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

yeh log kehtay hain kay Allah ney koi beta banaya huwa hai , ( halankay ) uss ki zaat ( iss qisam ki cheezon say ) pak hai , balkay aasmano aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ussi ka hai . sabb kay sabb uss kay farmanbardaar hain .
woh aasmano aur zameen ka mojid hai , aur jab woh kissi baat ka faisla kerta hai to uss kay baaray mein bus itna kehta hai kay :  hoja  chunacheh woh hojati hai .

aur jo log ilm nahi rakhtay woh kehtay hain kay : Allah hum say ( barah-e-raast ) kiyon baat nahi kerta-? ya humaray paas koi nishani kiyon nahi aati-? jo log inn say pehlay guzray hain woh bhi issi tarah ki baaten kehtay thay jaisi yeh kehtay hain . inn sabb kay dil aik jaisay hain . haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log yaqeen kerna chahen unn kay liye hum nishaniyan pehlay hi wazeh ker-chukay hain .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) beyshak hum ney tumhen ko haq dey ker iss tarah bheja hai kay tum ( jannat ki ) khushkhabri do aur ( jahannum say ) darao aur jo log ( apni marzi say ) jahannum ( ka raasta ) ikhtiyar ker-chukay hain unn kay baaray mein aap say koi baaz purs nahi hogi .

aur yahood o nasara tum say uss waqt tak hergiz razi nahi hon gay jab tak tum unn kay mazahab ki perwi nahi kero gay . keh do kay haqeeqi hidayat to Allah hi ki hidayat hai . aur tumharay paas ( wahi kay zariye ) jo ilm aagaya hai , agar kahen tum ney uss kay baad bhi inn logon  ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to tumhen Allah say bachaney kay liye naa koi himayati milay ga naa koi madadgaar .

jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di, jabkay woh uss ki tilawat iss tarah kertay hon jaisa uss ki tilawat ka haq hai , to woh log hi ( dar-haqeeqat ) uss per emaan rakhtay hain .   aur jo iss ka inkar kertay hon , to aesay log hi nuqsan uthaney walay hain
aey bani Israel ! meri woh naimat yaad kero jo mein ney tum ko ata ki thi , aur yeh baat ( yaad kero ) kay mein ney tum ko saray jahano per fazilat di thi .

aur uss din say daro jiss din koi shaks bhi kissi kay kuch kaam nahi aaye ga , naa kissi say kissi qisam ka fidya qubool kiya jaye ga , naa uss ko koi sifarish faeeda dey gi , aur naa unn ko koi madad phonchay gi .

aur ( woh waqt yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ko unn kay perwerdigar ney kaee baaton say aazmaya , aur unhon ney woh sari baaten poori ken , Allah ney ( unn say ) kaha :  mein tumhen tamam insanon ka peshwa bananey wala hun .  Ibrahim ney poocha :  aur meri aulad mein say-?  Allah ney farmaya :  mera ( yeh ) ehad zalimon ko shamil nahi hai .

aur woh waqt yaad karo jab hum ney baitullah ko logon  kay liye aesi jagah banaya jiss ki taraf woh lot lot ker jayen aur jo sarapa aman ho .   aur tum maqam-e-Ibrahim ko namaz parhney ki jagah bana lo .   aur hum ney Ibrahim aur Ismail ko yeh takeed ki kay :  tum dono meray ghar ko unn logon  kay liye pak karo jo ( yahan ) tawaf keren aur aetikaf mein bethen aur rukoo aur sajda baja layen .

aur ( woh waqt bhi yaad karo ) jab Ibrahim ney kaha tha kay :  aey meray perwerdigar ! iss ko aik pur aman shehar bana dijiye , aur iss kay bashindon mein say jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan layen unhen qisam qisam kay phalon say rizq ata farmaiye .  Allah ney kaha :  aur jo kufr ikhtiyar keray ga uss ko bhi mein kuch arsay kay liye lutf uthaney ka moaqa dun ga , ( magar ) phir ussay dozakh kay azab ki taraf kheench ley jaon ga . aur woh bad-tareen thikana hai .

aur uss waqt ka tasawwur kero jab Ibrahim baitullah ki buniyaden utha rahey thay ,   aur Ismail bhi ( unn kay sath shareek thay , aur dono yeh kehtay jatay thay kay : )  aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum say ( yeh khidmat ) qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , her aik ki sunney wala , her aik ko janney wala hai .

aey humaray perwerdigar ! hum dono ko apna mukammal farmanbardaar bana ley , aur humari nasal say bhi aesi ummat peda ker jo teri poori tabey daar ho . aur hum ko humari ibadton kay tareeqay sikha dey , aur humari tauba qubool farma ley . beyshak tu , aur sirf tu hi , moaaf ker-denay ka khoogar ( aur ) bari rehmat ka malik hai .

aur humaray perwerdigar ! inn mein aik aisa Rasool bhi bhejna jo inhi mein say ho , jo inn kay samney teri aayaton ki tilawat keray , enhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem dey , aur inn ko pakeezah banaye .   beyshak teri , aur sirf teri , zaat woh hai jiss ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , jiss ki hikmat bhi kamil .

aur kon hai jo Ibrahim kay tareeqay say inehraaf keray-? siwaye uss shaks kay jo khud apney aap ko himaqat mein mubtala ker-chuka ho ! haqeeqat to yeh hai kay hum ney duniya mein unhen ( apney liye ) chunn liya tha , aur aakhirat mein unn ka shumar sualeheen mein hoga .
jab unn kay perwerdigar ney unn say kaha kay :  sar-e-tasleem kham kerdo !    to woh ( foran ) bolay :  mein ney Rabb-ul-Aalameen kay ( her hukum kay ) aagay sar jhuka diya .

aur issi baat ki Ibrahim ney apney beton ko wasiyyat ki , aur Yaqoob ney bhi ( apney beton ko ) kay :  aey meray beto ! Allah ney yeh deen tumharay liye muntakhib farma liya hai , lehaza tumhen moat bhi aaye to iss halat mein aaye kay tum muslim ho .

kiya uss waqt tum khud mojood thay jab Yaqoob ki moat ka waqt aaya tha ,   jab unhon ney apney beton say kaha tha kay tum meray baad kiss ki ibadat kero gay-? unn sabb ney kaha tha kay : hum ussi aik khuda ki ibadat keren gay jo aap ka mabood hai aur aap kay baap dadon Ibrahim , Ismail aur Ishaq ka mabood hai . aur hum sirf ussi kay farmanbardaar hain .
woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay .

aur yeh ( yahudi aur essai musalmanon say ) kehtay hain kay :  tum yahudi ya essai hojao , raah-e-raast per aajao gay .  keh do kay :  nahi , balkay ( hum to ) Ibrahim kay deen ki perwi keren gay jo theek theek seedhi raah per thay , aur woh unn logon  mein say naa thay jo Allah kay sath kissi ko shareek thehratay hain .

. ( musalmano ) keh do kay :  hum Allah per emaan laye hain , aur uss kalam per bhi jo hum per utaara gaya aur uss per bhi jo Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki aulad per utaara gaya , aur uss per bhi jo musa aur essa ko diya gaya aur uss per bhi jo doosray payghumberon ko unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say ata huwa . hum unn payghumberon kay darmiyan koi tafreeq nahi kertay , aur hum ussi ( aik khuda ) kay tabey farman hain .

iss kay baad agar yeh log bhi issi tarah emaan ley ayen jaisay tum emaan laye ho to yeh raah-e-raast per aajayen gay . aur agar yeh mun morr len to dar-haqeeqat woh dushmani mein parr-gaye hain . abb Allah tumhari himayat mein unqareeb unn say nimat ley ga , aur woh her baat sunney wala , her baat janney wala hai .
. ( aey musalmano ! keh do kay : )  hum per to Allah ney apna rang charha diya hai , aur kon hai jo Allah say behtar rang charrhaye-? aur hum sirf ussi ki ibadat kertay hain .

keh do kay :  kiya tum hum say Allah kay baaray mein hujjat kertay ho-? halankay woh humara bhi perwerdigar hai aur tumhara bhi perwerdigar . ( yeh ) aur ( baat hai kay ) humaray aemal humaray liye hain , aur tumharay amal tumharay liye . aur hum ney to apni bandagi ussi kay liye khalis kerli hai .

bhala kiya tum yeh kehtay ho kay Ibrahim , Ismail , Ishaq , Yaqoob aur unn ki auladen yahudi ya nasrani then-? ( aey payghumber ! unn say ) kaho : kiya tum ziyada jantay ho ya Allah-? aur uss shaks say bara zalim kon hoga jo aesi shahadat ko chupaye jo uss kay paas Allah ki taraf say phonchi ho-?   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

. ( baharhal ! ) woh aik ummat thi jo guzar gaee . jo kuch unhon ney kamaya woh inn/unn ka hai , aur jo kuch tum ney kamaya , woh tumhara hai , aur tum say yeh nahi poocha jaye ga kay woh kiya amal kertay thay-?

abb yeh beywaqoof log kahen gay kay aakhir woh kiya cheez hai jiss ney inn ( musalmanon ) ko uss qiblay say rukh pherney per aamada kerdiya jiss ki taraf woh mun kertay chalay aarahey thay-? aap keh dijiye kay mashriq aur maghrib sabb Allah hi ki hain . woh jiss ko chahta hai seedhi raah ki hidayat ker deta hai

aur ( musalmano ! ) issi tarah to hum ney tum ko aik moatadil ummat banaya hai takay tum doosray logon  per gawah bano , aur Rasool tum per gawah banay .   aur jiss qiblay per tum pehlay kaar band thay , ussay hum ney kissi aur wajeh say nahi , balkay sirf yeh dekhney kay liye muqarrar kiya tha kay kon Rasool ka hukum manta hai aur kon ultay paon phir jata hai ?   aur iss mein shak nahi kay yeh baat thi bari mushkil , lekin unn logon  kay liye ( zara bhi mushkil naa hoi ) jinn ko Allah ney hidayat dey di thi . aur Allah taalaa aisa nahi kay tumharay emaan ko zaya kerday .   dar-haqeeqat Allah logon  per boht shafqat kernay wala , bara meharban hai .

. ( aey payghumber ! ) hum tumharay chehray ko baar baar aasman ki taraf uthtay huye dekh rahey hain . chunacheh hum tumhara rukh zaroor uss qiblay ki taraf pher den gay jo tumhen pasand hai .   lo abb apna rukh masjid-e-haram ki samt kerlo . aur ( aaenda ) jahan kahen tum ho apney chehron ka rukh ( namaz parhtay huye ) ussi ki taraf rakha kero . aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee hai woh khoob jantay hain kay yehi baat haq hai jo unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch yeh ker rahey hain Allah uss say ghafil nahi hai .

aur jinn logon  ko kitab di gaee thi agar tum unn kay paas her qisam ki nishaniyan ley aao tab bhi yeh tumharay qiblay ki perwi nahi keren gay . aur naa tum unn kay qiblay per amal kernay walay ho , naa yeh aik doosray kay qiblay per amal kernay walay hain .   aur jo ilm tumharay paas aa-chuka hai uss kay baad agar kahen tum ney inn ki khuwaishaat ki perwi kerli to uss soorat mein yaqeenan tumhara shumar zalimon mein hoga .

jinn logon  ko hum ney kitab di hai woh uss ko itni achi tarah pehchantay hain jaisay apney beton ko pehchantay hain .   aur yaqeen jano kay unn mein say kuch logon  ney haq ko jaan bojh ker chupa rakha hai .
aur haq wohi hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aaya hai , lehaza shak kernay walon mein hergiz shamil naa hojana .

aur her giroh ki aik samt hai jiss ki taraf woh rukh kerta hai . lehaza tum naik kamon mein aik doosray say aagay barhney ki koshish kero . tum jahan bhi hogay , Allah tum sabb ko ( apney paas ) ley aaye ga .   yaqeenan Allah her cheez per qadir hai .

aur tum jahan say bhi ( safar kay liye ) niklo , apna mun ( namaz kay waqt ) masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur yaqeenan yehi baat haq hai jo tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aai hai .   aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say bey khabar nahi hai .

aur jahan say bhi tum niklo , apna mun masjid-e-haram ki taraf kero . aur tum jahan kahen ho , apney chehray ussi ki taraf rakho , takay logon  ko tumharay khilaf hujjat bazi ka moaqa naa milay   albatta unn mein jo log zulm kay khoogar hain , ( woh kabhi khamosh naa hon gay ) so unn ka kuch khof naa rakho , haan mera khof rakho aur takay mein tum per apna inaam mukammal kerdun aur takay tum hidayat hasil kerlo .

. ( yeh inaam aisa hi hai ) jaisay hum ney tumharay darmiyan tum hi mein say aik Rasool bheja jo tumharay samney humari aayaton ki tilawat kerta hai , aur tumhen pakeezah banata hai , aur tumhen kitab aur hikmat ki taleem deta hai ,   aur tumhen woh baaten sikhata hai jo tum nahi jantay thay .
lehaza mujhay yaad kero , mein tumhen yaad rakhun ga . aur mera shukar ada kero , aur meri nashukri naa kero .
aey emaan walo ! sabar aur namaz say madad hasil kero .   beyshak Allah sabar kernay walon kay sath hai
aur jo log Allah kay raastay mein qatal hon unn ko murda naa kaho . darasal woh zinda hain , magar tum ko ( unn ki zindagi ka ) ehsas nahi hota

aur dekho hum tumhen aazmayen gay zaroor , ( kabhi ) khof say , aur ( kabhi ) bhook say , aur ( kabhi ) maal o jaan aur phalon mein kami ker kay . aur jo log ( aesay halaat mein ) sabar say kaam len unn ko khushkhabri suna do .
yeh woh log hain kay jab inn ko koi museebat phonchti hai to yeh kehtay hain kay   hum sabb Allah hi kay hain aur hum ko Allah hi ki taraf lot ker jana hai
yeh woh log hain jinn per unn kay perwerdigar ki taraf say khusoosi inayaten hain , aur rehmat hai . aur yehi log hain jo hidayat per hain .

beyshak safa aur marwa Allah ki nishaniyon mein say hain . lehaza jo shaks bhi baitullah ka hajj keray ya umrah keray to uss kay liye iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay woh unn kay darmiyan chakkar lagaye .   aur jo shaks khushi say koi bhalai ka kaam keray to Allah yaqeenan qadar daan ( aur ) janney wala hai .

beyshak woh log jo humari nazil ki hoi roshan daleelon aur hidayat ko chupatay hain , bawajood-yeh-kay hum unhen kitab mein khol khol ker logon  kay liye biyan ker-chukay hain ,   to aesay logon  per Allah bhi lanat bhejta hai aur doosray lanat kernay walay bhi lanat bhejtay hain

haan woh log jinhon ney tauba kerli ho aur apni islaah kerli ho aur ( chupai hoi baaton ko ) khol khol ker biyan kerdiya ho to mein aesay logon  ki tauba qubool kerleta hun . aur mein tauba qubool kernay ka khoogar hun , bara rehmat wala
beyshak woh log jinhon ney kufr ikhtiyar kiya aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , unn per Allah ki aur farishton ki aur saray insanon ki lanat hai
woh hamesha issi phitkaar mein rahen gay . naa unn per say azab ko halka kiya jaye ga , aur naa unn ko mohlat di jaye gi
tumhara khuda aik hi khuda hai . uss kay siwa koi khuda nahi jo sabb per meharban , boht meharban hai .

beyshak aasmano aur zameen ki takhleeq mein , raat din kay lagataar aaney janey mein , unn kashtiyon mein jo logon  kay faeeday ka saman leyker samandar mein terti hain , uss paani mein jo Allah ney aasman say utaara aur uss kay zariye zameen ko uss kay murda hojaney kay baad zindagi bakhshi aur uss mein her qisam kay janwer phela diye , aur hawaon ki gardish mein , aur unn badalon mein jo aasman aur zameen kay darmiyan tabey daar ban ker kaam mein lagay hoye hain , unn logon  kay liye nishaniyan hi nishaniyan hain jo apni aqal say kaam letay hain .

aur ( iss kay bawajood ) logon  mein kuch woh bhi hain jo Allah kay ilawa doosron ko uss ki khudai mein iss tarah shareek qarar detay hain kay unn say aesi mohabbat rakhtay hain jaisay Allah ki mohabbat ( rakhni chahiye ) . aur jo log emaan laa-chukay hain woh Allah hi say sabb say ziyada mohabbat rakhtay hain . aur kaash kay yeh zalim jab ( duniya mein ) koi takleef dekhtay hain ussi waqt yeh samajh liya keren kay tamam tarr taqat Allah hi ko hasil hai , aur yeh kay Allah ka azab ( aakhirat mein ) uss waqt bara sakht hoga .

jab woh ( peshwa ) jinn kay peechay yeh log chaltay rahey hain , apney perokaaron say mukammal bey talluqi ka aelaan keren gay , aur yeh sabb log azab ko apni aankhon kay samney dekh len gay , aur inn kay tamam bahami rishtay katt ker reh jayen gay

aur jinhon ney inn ( peshwaon ) ki perwi ki thi woh kahen gay kay kaash hamen aik martaba phir ( duniya mein ) loattney ka moaqa dey diya jaye , to hum bhi inn ( peshwaon ) say issi tarah bey talluqi ka aelaan keren jaisay unhon ney hum say bey talluqi ka aelaan kiya hai . iss tarah Allah enhen dikha dey ga kay inn kay aemal ( aaj ) inn kay liye hasrat hi hasrat ban chukay hain , aur abb woh kissi soorat dozakh say nikalney walay nahi hain .
aey logo ! zameen mein jo halal pakeezah cheezen hain woh khao ,   aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano kay woh tumharay liye aik khula dushman hai
woh to tum ko yehi hukum dey ga kay tum badi aur bey hayai kay kaam kero aur Allah kay zimmay woh baaten lagao jinn ka tumhen ilm nahi hai .

aur jab inn ( kafiron ) say kaha jata hai kay uss kalam ki perwi kero jo Allah ney utaara hai , to woh kehtay hain kay nahi ! hum to unn baaton ki perwi keren gay jinn per hum ney apney baap dadon ko paya hai . bhala kiya uss soorat mein bhi ( inn ko yehi chahiye ) jab unn kay baap daday ( deen ki ) zara bhi samajh naa rakhtay hon , aur unhon ney koi ( aasmani ) hidayat bhi hasil naa ki ho-?

aur jinn logon  ney kufr ko apna liya hai unn ( ko haq ki dawat denay ) ki misal kuch aesi hai jaisay koi shaks unn ( janweron ) ko zor zor say bulaye jo haank pukar kay siwa kuch nahi suntay . yeh behray , goongay andhay hain , lehaza kuch nahi samajhtay .
aey emaan walo ! jo pakeezah cheezen hum ney tumhen rizq kay tor per ata ki hain , unn mein say ( jo chahao ) khao , aur Allah ka shukar ada kero , agar waqaee tum sirf ussi ki bandagi kertay ho .

uss ney to tumharay liye bus murdar janwer , khoon , aur soowar haram kiya hai , neez woh janwer jis jiss per Allah kay siwa kissi aur ka naam pukara gaya ho .   haan agar koi shaks intehai majboori ki halat mein ho ( aur unn cheezon mein say kuch kha ley ) jabkay uss ka maqsad naa lazzat hasil kerna ho aur naa woh ( zaroorat ki ) hadd say aagay barhay , to uss per koi gunah nahi . yaqeenan Allah boht bakhshney wala bara meharban hai .

haqeeqat yeh hai kay jo log Allah ki nazil ki hoi kitab ko chupatay hain aur uss kay badlay thori si qeemat wasool kerletay hain , woh apney pet mein aag kay siwa kuch nahi bhar rahey . qayamat kay din Allah unn say kalam bhi nahi keray ga , aur naa unn ko pak keray ga , aur unn kay liye dardnak azab hai
yeh woh log hain jinhon ney hidayat kay badlay gumrahi , aur maghfirat kay badlay azab ki khareedaari kerli hai . chunacheh ( andaza kero kay ) yeh dozakh ki aag sehnay kay liye kitney tayyar hain !

yeh sabb kuch iss liye hoga kay Allah ney haq per mushtamil kitab utaari hai , aur jinn logon  ney aesi kitab kay baaray mein mukhalifat ka ravaiyya ikhtiyar kiya hai woh zida ziddi mein boht door nikal gaye hain .

naiki bus yehi to nahi hai kay apney chehray mashriq ya maghrib ki taraf kerlo ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay log Allah per , aakhirat kay din per , farishton per aur Allah ki kitabon aur uss kay nabiyon per emaan layen , aur Allah ki mohabbat mein apna maal rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno , musfiron aur saeelon ko den , aur ghulamon ko azad keraney mein kharch keren , aur namaz qaeem keren aur zakat ada keren , aur jab koi ehad kerlen to apney ehad ko poora kernay kay aadi hon , aur tangi aur takleef mein , neez jang kay waqt , sabar o istaqlal kay khoogar hon . aesay log hain jo sachay ( kehlaney kay mustahiq ) hain , aur yehi log hain jo muttaqi hain .

aey emaan walo ! jo log ( jaan boojh ker nahaq ) qatal kerdiye jayen unn kay baaray mein tum per qisaas ( ka hukum ) farz kerdiya gaya hai . azad kay badlay azad , ghulam kay badlay ghulam aur aurat kay badlay aurat ( hi ko qatal kiya jaye )   , phir agar qatil ko uss kay bhai ( yani maqtool kay waris ) ki taraf say kuch moaafi dey di jaye   to maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq ( khoon baha ka ) mutalba kerna ( waris ka ) haq hai , aur ussay khush asloobi say ada kerna ( qatil ka ) farz hai . yeh tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say aik aasani peda ki gaee hai aur aik rehmat hai . iss kay baad bhi koi ziyadti keray to woh dardnak azab ka mustahiq hai
aur aey aqal rakhney walo ! tumharay liye qisaas mein zindagi ( ka saman hai ) umeed hai kay tum ( iss ki khilaf warzi say ) bacho gay .

tum per farz kiya gaya hai kay agar tum mein say koi , apney peechay maal chorr ker janey wala ho to jab uss ki moat ka waqt qareeb aajaye , woh apney walaiden aur qareebi rishta daaron kay haq mein dastoor kay mutabiq wasiyyat keray .   yeh muttaqi logon  kay zimmay aik lazimi haq hai

phir jo shaks iss wasiyyat ko sunney kay baad uss mein koi tabdeeli keray ga , to uss ka gunah unn logon  per hoga jo uss mein tabdeeli keren gay .   yaqeen rakho kay Allah ( sabb kuch ) sunta janta hai

haan agar kissi shaks ko yeh andesha ho kay koi wasiyyat kernay wala bey jaa taraf daari ya gunah ka irtikab ker raha hai , aur woh mutalliqa aadmiyon kay darmiyan sulah kera dey to uss per koi gunah nahi .   beyshak Allah taalaa boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aey emaan walo ! tum per rozay farz kerdiye gaye hain , jiss tarah tum say pehlay logon  per farz kiye gaye thay , takay tumharay andar taqwa peda ho

ginti kay chand din rozay rakhney hain . phir bhi agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . aur jo log iss ki taqat rakhtay hon woh aik miskeen ko khana khila ker ( rozay ka ) fidya ada kerden   iss kay ilawa agar koi shaks apni khushi say koi naiki keray to yeh uss kay haq mein behtar hai . aur agar tum ko samajh ho to rozay rakhney mein tumharay liye ziyada behtari hai

ramzan ka maheena woh hai jiss mein Quran nazil kiya gaya jo logon  kay liye sarapa hidayat , aur aesi roshan nishaniyon ka hamil hai jo sahih raasta dikhati aur haq o batil kay darmiyan do tok faisla ker-deti hain , lehaza tum mein say jo shaks bhi yeh maheena paye , woh iss mein zaroor roza rakhay . aur agar koi shaks beemar ho ya safar per ho to woh doosray dino mein itni hi tadaad poori kerlay . Allah tumharay sath aasani ka moamla kerna chahta hai , aur tumharay liye mushkil peda kerna nahi chahta , takay ( tum rozon ki ) ginti poori kerlo , aur Allah ney tumhen jo raah dikhai uss per Allah ki takbeer kaho ,   aur takay tum shukar guzaar bano .

aur ( aey payghumber ! ) jab meray banday aap say meray baaray mein poochen to ( aap unn say keh dijiye kay ) mein itna qareeb hun kay jab koi mujhay pukarta hai to mein pukarney walay ki pukar sunta hun .   lehaza woh bhi meri baat dil say qubool keren , aur mujh per emaan layen , takay woh raah-e-raast per aajayen .

tumharay liye halal kerdiya gaya hai kay rozon ki raat mein tum apni biwiyon say bey takalluf sohbat kero . woh tumharay liye libas hain , aur tum unn kay liye libas ho . Allah ko ilm tha kay tum apney aap say khayanat ker rahey thay , phir uss ney tum per inayat ki aur tumhari ghalati moaaf farma-di ,   chunacheh abb tum unn say sohbat kerliya kero , aur jo kuch Allah ney tumharay liye likh rakha hai ussay talab kero ,   aur uss waqt tak khao piyo jab tak subha ki safaid dhaari siyah dhaari say mumtaz ho ker tum per wazeh ( naa ) hojaye . uss kay baad raat aaney tak rozay pooray kero . aur inn ( apni biwiyon ) say uss halat mein mubashrat naa kero jab tum masjidon mein aetikaf mein bethay ho . yeh Allah ki ( muqarrar ki hoi ) hudood hain , lehaza inn ( ki khilaf warzi ) kay qareeb bhi matt jana . issi tarah Allah apni nishaniyan logon  kay samney khol khol ker biyan kerta hai , takay woh taqwa ikhtiyar keren .

aur aapas mein aik doosray ka maal nahaq tareeqon say naa khao , aur naa unn ka muqadma hakimon kay paas iss gharz say ley jao kay logon  kay maal ka koi hissa jantay boojhtay harrap kernay ka gunah kero .

log aap say naye maheenon kay chaand kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap unhen bata dijiye kay yeh logon  kay ( mukhtalif moamlaat kay ) aur hajj kay oqaat mutayyan kernay kay liye hain .  
  aur yeh koi naiki nahi hai kay tum gharon mein unn ki pusht ki taraf say dakhil ho ,   balkay naiki yeh hai kay insan taqwa ikhtiyar keray , aur tum gharon mein unn kay darwazon say dakhil huwa kero , aur Allah say dartay raho , takay tumhen falah hasil ho .
aur unn logon  say Allah kay raastay mein jang kero jo tum say jang kertay hain , aur ziyadti naa kero . yaqeen jano kay Allah ziyadti kernay walon ko pasand nahi kerta .

aur tum unn logon  ko jahan pao qatal kero , aur unhen uss jagah say nikal bahir kero jahan say unhon ney tumhen nikala tha . aur fitna qatal say ziyada sangeen burai hai .   aur tum unn say masjid-e-haram kay paas uss waqt tak larraee naa kero jab tak woh khud uss mein tum say larraee shuroo naa keren . haan agar woh tum say uss mein larraee shuroo kerden to tum unn ko qatal ker-saktay ho . aesay kafiron ki saza yehi hai
phir agar woh baaz aajayen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai

aur tum unn say larrtay raho yahan tak kay fitna baqi naa rahey , aur deen Allah ka hojaye .   phir agar woh baaz aajayen to ( samajh lo kay ) tashaddud siwaye zalimon kay kissi per nahi hona chahiye .

hurmat walay maheenay ka badla hurmat wala maheena hai , aur hurmaton per bhi badlay kay ehkaam jari hotay hain .   chunacheh agar koi shaks tum per koi ziyadti keray to tum bhi wesi hi ziyadti uss per kero jaisi ziyadti uss ney tum per ki ho , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur achi tarah samajh lo kay Allah unhi ka sathi hai jo uss ka khof dil mein rakhtay hain
aur Allah kay raastay mein maal kharch kero , aur apney aap ko khud apney haathon halakat mein naa daalo ,   aur naiki ikhtiyar kero . beyshak Allah naiki kernay walon say mohabbat kerta hai .

aur hajj aur umrah Allah kay liye poora poora ada kero , haan agar tumhen rok diya jaye to jo qurbani moyassar ho , ( Allah kay huzoor paish kerdo ) .   aur apney sar uss waqt tak naa mundao jab tak qurbani apni jagah naa phonch jaye . haan agar tum mein say koi shaks beemar ho , ya uss kay sar mein koi takleef ho to rozon ya sadqay ya qurbani ka fidya dey .   phir jab tum aman hasil kerlo to jo shaks hajj kay sath umray ka faeeda bhi uthaye woh jo qurbani moyassar ho ( Allah kay huzoor paish keray ) . haan agar kissi kay paas iss ki taqat naa ho to woh hajj kay dino mein teen rozay rakhay , aur saat ( rozay ) uss waqt jab tum ( gharon ko ) loat jao . iss tarah yeh kul das rozay hon gay .   yeh hukum unn logon  kay liye hai jinn kay ghar walay masjid-e-haram kay paas naa rehtay hon   . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah ka azab bara sakht hai .

hajj kay chand mutayyan maheenay hain . chunacheh jo shaks inn maheenon mein ( ehraam baandh ker ) apney oopper hajj lazim kerlay to hajj kay doran naa woh koi fohash baat keray , naa koi gunah , naa koi jhagrra . aur tum jo koi naik kaam kero gay , Allah ussay jaan ley ga . aur ( hajj kay safar mein ) zaad-e-raah sath ley jaya kero , kiyonkay behtareen zaad-e-raah taqwa hai .   aur aey aqal walo ! meri nafarmani say dartay raho

tum per iss baat mein koi gunah nahi hai kay tum ( hajj kay doran tijarat ya mazdoori kay zariye ) apney perwerdigar ka fazal talash kero .   phir jab tum arafaat say rawana ho to mashar-e-haram kay paas ( jo muzdalfa mein waqay hai ) Allah ka ziker kero , aur uss ka ziker ussi tarah kero jiss tarah uss ney tumhen hidayat ki hai ,   jabkay iss say pehlay tum bilkul na-waqif thay

iss kay ilawa ( yeh baat bhi yaad rakho kay ) tum ussi jagah say rawana ho jahan say aam log rawana hotay hain .   aur Allah say maghfirat maango . beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

phir jab tum apney hajj kay kaam pooray ker-chuko to Allah ka iss tarah ziker kero jaisay tum apney baap dadon ka ziker kiya kertay ho , balkay uss say bhi ziyada ziker kero .   abb baaz log to woh hain jo ( dua mein bus ) yeh kehtay hain kay :  " aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhalai ata farma " aur aakhirat mein unn ka koi hissa nahi hota
aur unhi mein say woh bhi hain jo yeh kehtay hain kay :   aey humaray perwerdigar ! hamen duniya mein bhi bhalai ata farma aur aakhirat mein bhi bhalai , aur hamen dozakh kay azab say bacha ley
yeh woh log hain jinhen apney aemal ki kamai ka hissa ( sawab ki soorat mein ) milay ga , aur Allah jald hisab lenay wala hai .

aur Allah ko ginti kay ( unn chand ) dino mein ( jab tum mina mein muqeem ho ) yaad kertay raho . phir jo shaks do hi din mein jaldi chala jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi hai , aur jo shaks ( aik din ) baad mein jaye uss per bhi koi gunah nahi .   yeh ( tafseel ) uss kay liye hai jo taqwa ikhtiyar keray . aur tum sabb taqwa ikhtiyar kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum sabb ko ussi ki taraf ley jaa ker jama kiya jaye ga

aur logon  mein aik woh shaks bhi hai kay dunyawi zindagi kay baaray mein uss ki baaten tumhen bari achi lagti hain , aur jo kuch uss kay dil mein hai uss per woh Allah ko gawah bhi banata hai , halankay woh ( tumharay ) dushmanon mein sabb say ziyada kattar hai
aur jab uth ker jata hai to zameen mein uss ki dorr dhoop iss liye hoti hai kay woh uss mein fasad machaye , aur faslen aur naslen tabah keray , halankay Allah fasad ko pasand nahi kerta
aur jab uss say kaha jata hai kay Allah ka khof ker , to nakhwat uss ko gunah per aur aamada ker-deti hai . chunacheh aesay shaks ko to jahannum hi raas aaye gi ,

aur yaqeen kero woh boht bura bichona hai aur ( doosri taraf ) logon  mein woh shaks bhi hai jo Allah ki khushnoodi ki khatir apni jaan ka soda kerleta hai ,   aur Allah ( aesay ) bandon per bara meharban hai .
aey emaan walo ! Islam mein pooray kay pooray dakhil hojao , aur shetan kay naqsh-e-qadam per naa chalo . yaqeen jano woh tumhara khula dushman hai
phir jo roshan dalaeel tumharay paas aa-chukay hain , agar tum unn kay baad bhi ( raah-e-raast say ) phisal gaye to yaad rakho kay Allah iqtidar mein bhi kamil hai , hikmat mein bhi kamil

yeh ( kuffaar emaan laney kay liye ) uss kay siwa kiss baat ka intizar ker rahey hain kay Allah khud badal kay sayebanon mein unn kay samney aa-mojood ho , aur farishtay bhi ( uss kay sath hon ) aur sara moamla abhi chuka diya jaye ?   halankay aakhir kaar saray moamlaat Allah hi ki taraf to loat ker rahen gay

bani Israel say poocho hum ney unn ko kitni sari khuli nishaniyan di then ! aur jiss shaks kay paas Allah ki naimat aa-chuki ho , phir woh uss ko badal daalay , to ( ussay yaad rakhna chahiye kay ) Allah ka azab bara sakht hai

jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay liye dunyawi zindagi bari dilkash bana di gaee hai , aur woh ehal-e-emaan ka mazaq uratay hain , halankay jinhon ney taqwa ikhtiyar kiya hai woh qayamat kay din inn say kahen buland hon gay . aur Allah jiss ko chahta hai bey hisab rizq deta hai .

. ( shuroo mein ) saray insan aik hi deen kay pero thay . phir ( jab unn mein ikhtilaf huwa to ) Allah ney nabi bhejay jo ( haq walon ko ) khushkhabri sunatay , aur ( batil walon ko ) daratay thay , aur unn kay sath haq per mushtamil kitab nazil ki , takay woh logon  kay darmiyan unn baaton ka faisla keray jinn mein unn ka ikhtilaf tha . aur ( afsos ki baat yeh hai kay ) kissi aur ney nahi balkay khud unhon ney jinn ko woh kitab di gaee thi , roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad bhi , sirf bahami zidd ki wajeh say issi ( kitab ) mein ikhtilaf nikal liya . phir jo log emaan laye Allah ney unhen apney hukum say haq ki unn baaton mein raah-e-raast tak phonchaya jinn mein unhon ney ikhtilaf kiya tha , aur Allah jissay chahta hai raah-e-raast tak phoncha deta hai .

. ( musalmano ! ) kiya tum ney yeh samajh rakha hai kay tum jannat mein ( yunhi ) dakhil hojao gay , halankay abhi tumhen uss jaisay halaat paish nahi aaye jaisay unn logon  ko paish aaye thay jo tum say pehlay ho guzray hain . unn per sakhtiyan aur takleefen ayen , aur unhen halla daala gaya , yahan tak kay Rasool aur unn kay emaan walay sathi bol uthay kay   Allah ki madad kab aaye gi ?" , yaad rakho ! Allah ki madad nazdeek hai .

log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay jo maal bhi tum kharch kero woh walaiden , qareebi rishta daaron , yateemon , miskeeno aur musfiron kay liye hona chahiye . aur tum bhalai ka jo kaam bhi kero , Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

tum per ( dushmanon say ) jang kerna farz kiya gaya hai , aur woh tum per giraan hai . aur yeh aen mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko bura samjho halankay woh tumharay haq mein behtar ho . aur yeh bhi mumkin hai kay tum aik cheez ko pasand kero , halankay woh tumharay haq mein buri ho . aur ( asal haqeeqat to ) Allah janta hai , aur tum nahi jantay .

log aap say hurmat walay maheenay kay baaray mein poochtay hain kay uss mein jang kerna kaisa hai ?   aap keh dijiye kay uss mein jang kerna bara gunah hai , magar logon  ko Allah kay raastay say rokna , uss kay khilaf kufr ki rawish ikhtiyar kerna , masjid-e-haram per bandish lagana aur uss kay baasiyon ko wahan say nikal bahir kerna Allah kay nazdeek ziyada bara gunah hai . aur fitna qatal say bhi ziyada sangeen cheez hai . aur yeh ( kafir ) tum logon  say barabar jang kertay rahen gay , yahan tak kay agar inn ka bus chalay to yeh tum ko tumhara deen chorney per aamada kerden . aur agar tum mein say koi shaks apna deen chorr dey , aur kafir honey ki halat hi mein maray , to aesay logon  kay aemal duniya aur aakhirat dono mein ikarat hojayen gay . aesay log dozakh walay hain . woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

. ( iss kay bar-khilaf ) jo log emaan laye aur jinhon ney hijrat ki aur Allah kay raastay mein jihad kiya , to woh beyshak Allah ki rehmat kay umeedwaar hain , aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .

log aap say sharab aur joye kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay inn dono mein bara gunah bhi hai , aur logon  kay liye kuch faeeday bhi hain , aur inn dono ka gunah inn kay faeeday say ziyada barha huwa hai .   aur log aap say poochtay hain kay woh ( Allah ki khushnoodi kay liye ) kiya kharch keren-? aap keh dijiye kay   jo tumhari zaroorat say zaeed ho " .   Allah issi tarah apney ehkaam tumharay liye saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay tum ghor-o-fiker say kaam lo .

duniya kay baaray mein bhi aur aakhirat kay baaray mein bhi . aur log aap say yateemon kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay unn ki bhalai chahana naik kaam hai , aur agar tum unn kay sath mil jul ker raho to ( kuch harj nahi kiyonkay ) woh tumharay bhai hi to hain . aur Allah khoob janta hai kay kon moamlaat bigaarney wala hai . aur kon sanwarney wala . aur agar Allah chahta to tumhen mushkil mein daal deta .   yaqeenan Allah ka iqtidar bhi kamil hai , hikmat bhi kamil .

aur mushrik aurton say uss waqt tak nikah naa kero jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . yaqeenan aik momin baandi kissi bhi mushrik aurat say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik aurat tumhen pasand aarahi ho . aur apni aurton ka nikah mushrik mardon say naa kerao jab tak woh emaan naa ley ayen . aur yaqeenan aik momin ghulam kissi bhi mushrik mard say behtar hai , khuwa woh mushrik mard tumhen pasand aaraha ho . yeh sabb dozakh ki taraf bulatay hain , jabkay Allah apney hukum say jannat aur maghfirat ki taraf bulata hai , aur apney ehkaam logon  kay samney saaf saaf biyan kerta hai takay woh naseehat hasil keren .

aur log aap say haiz kay baaray mein poochtay hain . aap keh dijiye kay woh gandagi hai lehaza haiz ki halat mein aurton say alag raho , aur jab tak woh pak naa hojayen unn say qurbat ( yani jamaa ) naa kero . haan jab woh pak hojayen to unn kay paas ussi tareeqay say jao jiss tarah Allah ney tumhen hukum diya hai . beyshak Allah unn logon  say mohabbat kerta hai jo uss ki taraf kasrat say rujoo keren aur unn say mohabbat kerta hai jo khoob pak saaf rahen .

tumhari biwiyan tumharay liye khetiyan hain : lehaza apni kheti mein jahan say chahao jao   aur apney liye ( achay amal ) aagay bhejo , aur Allah say dartay raho , aur yaqeen rakho kay tum uss say jaker milney walay ho . aur mominon ko khush khabri suna do .

aur Allah ( kay naam ) ko apni qasmon mein iss gharz say istimal naa kero kay uss kay zariye naiki aur taqwa kay kamon aur logon  kay darmiyan sulah safai keraney say bach sako .   aur Allah sabb kuch sunta janta hai .

Allah tumhari laghw qasmon per tumhari girift nahi keray ga   , albatta jo qasmen tum ney apney dilon kay iraday say khai hon gi unn per girift keray ga . aur Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

jo log apni biwiyon say ielaa kertay hain ( yani unn kay paas naa janey ki qasam kha letay hain ) unn kay liye chaar maheenay ki mohlat hai   . chunacheh agar woh ( qasam torr ker ) rujoo kerlen to beyshak Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara meharban hai .
aur agar unhon ney talaq hi ki thaan li ho to ( bhi ) Allah sunney janney wala hai .

aur jinn aurton ko talaq dey di gaee ho woh teen martaba haiz aaney tak apney aap ko intizar mein rakhen   aur agar woh Allah per aur aakhirat kay din per emaan rakhti hon to unn kay liye halal nahi hai kay Allah ney unn kay reham mein jo kuch ( hamal ya haiz ) peda kiya hai ussay chupayen . aur iss mauddat mein agar unn kay shohar halaat behtar banana chahen to unn ko haq hai kay woh unn aurton ko ( apni zojiyat ) mein wapis ley len . aur unn aurton ko maroof tareeqay kay mutabiq wesay hi huqooq hasil hain jaisay ( mardon ko ) unn per hasil hain . haan mardon ko unn per aik darja foqiyat hai   aur Allah ghalib aur hikmat wala hai .

talaq ( ziyada say ziyada ) do baar honi chahiye . uss kay baad ( shohar kay liye do hi raastay hain ) ya to qaeeday kay mutabiq ( biwi ko ) rok rakhay ( yani talaq say rujoo kerlay ) ya khush asloobi say chorr dey ( yani rujoo kay baghair iddat guzar janey dey ) . aur ( aey shohro ! ) tumharay liye halal nahi hai kay tum ney unn ( biwiyon ) ko jo kuch diya ho woh ( talaq kay badlay ) unn say wapis lo , illa yeh kay dono ko iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh ( nikah baqi rehney ki soorat mein ) Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood ko qaeem nahi rakh saken gay   . chunacheh agar tumhen iss baat ka andesha ho kay woh dono Allah ki hudood ko qaeem naa rakh saken gay to unn dono kay liye iss mein koi gunah nahi hai kay aurat maali moawza dey ker alehdgi hasil kerlay . yeh Allah ki muqarrar ki hoi hudood hain , lehaza inn say tajawuz naa kero . aur jo log Allah ki hudood say tajawuz kertay hain woh baray zalim log hain .

phir agar shohar ( teesri ) talaq deydey to woh ( mutlaqa aurat ) uss kay liye uss waqt tak halal nahi hogi jab tak woh kissi aur shohar say nikah naa keray , haan agar woh ( doosra shohar bhi ) ussay talaq deydey to unn dono per koi gunah nahi kay woh aik doosray kay paas ( naya nikah ker kay ) dobara wapis aajayen , ba-shartey-kay unhen yeh ghalib gumaan ho kay abb woh Allah ki hudood qaeem rakhen gay . aur yeh sabb Allah ki hudood hain jo woh unn logon  kay liye wazeh ker raha hai jo samajh rakhtay hon .

aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho aur woh apni iddat kay qareeb phonch jayen , to ya to unn ko bhalai kay sath ( apni zojiyat mein ) rok rakho , ya unhen bhalai kay sath chorr do . aur unhen sataney ki khatir iss liye rok ker naa rakho kay unn per zulm ker-sako . aur jo shaks aisa keray ga woh khud apni jaan per zulm keray ga . aur Allah ki aayaton ko mazaq matt banao aur Allah ney tum per jo inaam farmaya hai ussay , aur tum per jo kitab aur hikmat ki baaten tumhen naseehat kernay kay liye nazil ki hain unhen yaad rakho . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah her cheez ko khoob janta hai .

aur jab tum ney aurton ko talaq dey di ho , aur woh apni iddat ko phonch jayen , to ( aey meykay walo ! ) unhen iss baat say mana naa kero kay woh apney ( pehlay ) shohron say ( dobara ) nikah keren , ba-shartey-kay woh bhalai kay sath aik doosray say razi hogaye hon .   inn baaton ki naseehat tum mein say unn logon  ko ki jarahi hai jo Allah aur yoam-e-aakhirat per emaan rakhtay hon . yehi tumharay liye ziyada suthra aur pakeezah tareeqa hai . Allah janta hai aur tum nahi jantay .

aur mayen apney bacchon ko pooray do saal tak doodh pilayen . yeh mauddat inn kay liye hai jo doodh pilaney ki mauddat poori kerna chahen . aur jiss baap ka woh baccha hai uss per wajib hai kay woh maroof tareeqay per unn maon kay khaney aur libas ka kharch uthaye   . ( haan ) kissi shaks ko uss ki wusat say ziyada takleef nahi di jati . naa to maa ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say sataya jaye , aur naa baap ko apney bacchay ki wajeh say   . aur issi tarah ki zimma daari waris per bhi hai   . phir agar woh dono ( yani walaiden ) aapas ki raza mandi aur bahami mashwaray say ( do saal guzarney say pehlay hi ) doodh churana chahen to uss mein bhi unn per koi gunah nahi hai . aur agar tum yeh chahao kay apney bacchon ko kissi ana say doodh pilwao to bhi tum per koi gunah nahi , jabkay tum ney jo ujrat thehrai thi woh ( doodh pilaney wali ana ko ) bhalay tareeqay say dey do . aur Allah say dartay raho , aur jaan rakho kay Allah tumharay saray kamon ko achi tarah dekh raha hai .

aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen , aur biwiyan chorr ker jayen to woh biwiyan apney aap ko chaar maheenay aur das din intizar mein rakhen gi . phir jab woh apni ( iddat ki ) miyaad ko phonch jayen to woh apney baaray mein jo kaarawai ( maslan doosra nikah ) qaeeday kay mutabiq keren to tum per kuch gunah nahi . aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah uss say poori tarah ba-khabar hai .

aur ( iddat kay doran ) agar tum unn aurton ko isharay kanaye mein nikah ka paygham do ya ( unn say nikah ka irada ) dil mein chupaye rakho to tum per koi gunah nahi hai . Allah janta hai kay tum unn ( say nikah ) ka khayal to dil mein lao gay , lekin unn say nikah ka do tarfa wada matt kerna , illa yeh kay munasib tareeqay say koi baat keh do   . aur nikah ka aqd paka kernay ka uss waqt tak irada bhi matt kerna jab tak iddat ki muqarrara mauddat apni miyaad ko naa phonch jaye . aur yaad rakho kay jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai Allah ussay khoob janta hai ; lehaza uss say dartay raho ; aur yaad rakho kay Allah boht bakhshney wala , bara burdbaar hai .

tum per iss mein bhi koi gunah nahi hai kay tum aurton ko aesay waqt talaq do jabkay abhi tum ney unn ko chooa bhi naa ho , aur naa unn kay liye koi mehar muqarrar kiya ho , aur ( aesi soorat mein ) unn ko koi tohfa do   , khushal shaks apni haisiyat kay mutabiq aur gharib aadmi apni haisiyat kay mutabiq bhalay tareeqay say yeh tohfa dey . yeh naik aadmiyon per aik lazimi haq hai .

aur agar tum ney unhen chooney say pehlay hi iss halat mein talaq di ho jabkay unn kay liye ( nikah kay waqt ) koi mehar muqarrar kerliya tha to jitna mehar tum ney muqarrar kiya tha uss ka aadha dena ( wajib hai ) illa yeh kay woh aurten riyat kerden ( aur aadhay mehar ka bhi mutalba naa keren ) ya woh ( shohar ) jiss kay haath mein nikah ki girah hai , riyat keray ( aur poora mehar deydey ) aur agar tum riyat kero to yeh taqwa kay ziyada qareeb hai . aur aapas mein faraakh dili ka bartao kerna matt bhoolo . jo amal bhi tum kertay ho , Allah yaqeenan ussay dekh raha hai .
tamam namazon ka poora poora khayal rakho , aur ( khaas tor per ) bech ki namaz ka   . aur Allah kay samney ba-adab farmanbardaar ban ker kharray huwa kero .

aur agar tumhen ( dushman ka ) khof laahaq ho to kharray kharray ya sawar honey ki halat hi mein ( namaz parh lo )   phir jab tum aman ki halat mein aajao to Allah ka ziker uss tareeqay say kero jo uss ney tumhen sikhaya hai jiss say tum pehlay na-waqif thay

aur tum mein say jo log wafaat paajayen aur apney peechay biwiyan chorr jayen to woh apni biwiyon kay haq mein yeh wasiyyat ker jaya keren kay aik saal tak woh ( tarkay say nafqa wasool kernay ka ) faeeda uthayen gi aur unn ko ( shohar kay ghar say ) nikala nahi jaye ga .   haan agar woh khud nikal jayen to apney haq mein qaeeday kay mutabiq woh jo kuch bhi keren uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi hoga . aur Allah sahab-e-iqtidar bhi hai , sahab-e-hikmat bhi .
aur mutlaqa aurton ko qaeeday kay mutabiq faeeda phonchana muttaqiyon per unn ka haq hai .
Allah apney ehkaam issi tarah wazahat say tumharay samney biyan kerta hai , takay tum samajh daari say kaam lo .

kiya tumhen unn logon  ka haal maloom nahi huwa jo moat say bachnay kay liye apney gharon say nikal aaye thay , aur woh hazaron ki tadaad mein thay ? chunacheh Allah ney unn say kaha :  mar jao  phir unhen zinda kiya .   haqeeqat yeh hai kay Allah logon  per boht fazal farmaney wala hai , lekin aksar log shukar ada nahi kertay .
aur Allah kay raastay mein jang kero , aur yaqeen rakho kay Allah khoob sunney wala , khoob janney wala hai .

kon hai jo Allah ko achay tareeqay per qarz dey , takay woh ussay uss kay mafad mein itna barhaye charrhaye kay woh badar jaha ziyada hojaye ?   aur Allah hi tangi peda kerta hai , aur wohi wusat deta hai , aur ussi ki taraf tum sabb ko lotaya jaye ga .

kiya tumhen musa kay baad bani Israel kay giroh kay uss waqaey ka ilm nahi huwa jab unhon ney apney aik nabi say kaha tha kay humara aik badshah muqarrar ker-dijiye takay ( uss kay jhandey talay ) hum Allah kay raastay mein jang ker-saken .   nabi ney kaha :  kiya tum logon  say yeh baat kuch baeed hai kay jab tum per jang farz ki jaye to tum naa larro-?  unhon ney kaha :  bhala hamen kiya hojaye ga jo hum Allah kay raastay mein jang naa keren gay halankay hamen apney gharon aur apney bacchon kay paas say nikal bahir kiya gaya hai .  phir ( huwa yehi kay ) jab unn per jang farz ki gaee to unn mein say thoray logon  ko chorr ker baqi sabb peeth pher gaye . aur Allah zalimon ko khoob janta hai .

aur unn kay nabi ney unn say kaha kay :  Allah ney tumharay liye taloot ko badshah bana ker bheja hai .  kehney lagay :  bhala uss ko hum per badshahat kernay ka haq kahan say aagaya-? hum uss kay muqablay mein badshahat kay ziyada mustahiq hain . aur uss ko to maali wusat bhi hasil nahi .  nabi ney kaha :  Allah ney unn ko tum per fazilat dey ker chuna hai , aur unhen ilm aur jism mein ( tum say ) ziyada wusat ata ki hai . aur Allah apna mulk jiss ko chahta hai deta hai . aur Allah bari wusat aur bara ilm rakhney wala hai .

aur inn say unn kay nabi ney yeh bhi kaha kay :  taloot ki badshahat ki alamat yeh hai kay tumharay paas woh sandooq ( wapis ) aajaye ga jiss mein tumharay perwerdigar ki taraf say sakeenat ka saman hai , aur musa aur Haroon ney jo ashiya chorri then unn mein say kuch baqi maandda cheezen hain . ussay farishtay uthaye huye layen gay   agar tum momin ho to tumharay liye uss mein bari nishani hai .

chunacheh jab taloot lashkar kay sath rawana huwa to uss ney ( lashkar walon say ) kaha kay :  Allah aik darya kay zariye tumhara imtihan lenay wala hai . jo shaks iss darya say paani piye ga woh mera aadmi nahi hoga , aur jo issay nahi chakhay ga woh mera aadmi hoga , illa yeh kay koi apney haath say aik chullu bhar ley ( to kuch harj nahi ) .    phir ( huwa yeh kay ) unn mein say thoray aadmiyon kay siwa baqi sabb ney uss darya say ( khoob ) paani piya . chunacheh jab woh ( yani taloot ) aur uss kay sath emaan rakhney walay darya kay paar utray , to yeh log ( jinhon ney taloot ka hukum nahi maana tha ) kehney lagay kay :  aaj jaloot aur uss kay lashkar ka muqabla kernay ki hum mein bilkul taqat nahi hai .  ( magar ) jinn logon  ka emaan tha kay woh Allah say jaa milney walay hain unhon ney kaha kay :  najaney kitni choti jamaten hain jo Allah kay hukum say bari jamaton per ghalib aai hain . aur Allah unn logon  ka sathi hai jo sabar say kaam letay hain .

aur jab yeh log jaloot aur uss kay lashkaron kay aamney samney huye to inhon ney kaha :  aey humaray perwerdigar ! sabar o istaqlal ki sift hum per undel dey , hamen sabit qadmi bakhsh dey , aur hamen iss kafir qoam kay muqablay mein fatah o nusrat ata farmadey .

chunacheh inhon ney Allah kay hukum say unn ( jaloot kay sathiyon ) ko shikast di aur dawood ney jaloot ko qatal kiya ,   aur Allah ney uss ko saltanat aur danai ata ki , aur jo ilm chaha uss ko ata farmaya . agar Allah logon  ka aik doosray kay zariye difaa naa keray to zameen mein fasad phel jaye , lekin Allah tamam jahano per bara fazal farmaney wala hai .
yeh Allah ki aayaat hain jo hum aap kay samney theek theek parh ker sunatay hain , aur aap beyshak unn payghumberon mein say hain jo Rasool bana ker bhejay gaye hain .

yeh payghumber jo hum ney ( makhlooq ki islaah kay liye ) bhejay hain , inn ko hum ney aik doosray per fazilat ata ki hai . inn mein say baaz woh hain jinn say Allah ney kalam farmaya , aur inn mein say baaz ko uss ney badarjaha bulandi ata ki .   aur hum ney essa ibn-e-maryam ko khuli nishaniyan den , aur rooh-ul-qudus say unn ki madad farmaee .   aur agar Allah chahta to unn kay baad walay log apney paas roshan dalaeel aajaney kay baad aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin unhon ney khud ikhtilaf kiya , chunacheh unn mein say kuch woh thay jo emaan laye , aur kuch woh jinhon ney kufr apnaya . aur agar Allah chahta to woh aapas mein naa larrtay , lekin Allah wohi kerta hai jo woh chahta hai .

aey emaan walo ! jo rizq hum ney tumhen diya hai uss mein say woh din aaney say pehlay pehlay ( Allah kay raastay mein ) kharch kerlo jiss din naa koi soda hoga , naa koi dosti ( kaam aaye gi ) , aur naa koi sifarish hosakay gi .   aur zalim woh log hain jo kufr ikhtiyar kiye huye hain .

Allah woh hai jiss kay siwa koi mabood nahi jo sada zinda hai . jo poori kainat sanbhalay huye hai ; jiss ko naa kabhi oongh lagti hai , naa neend . aasmano mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) aur zameen mein jo kuch hai ( woh bhi ) , sabb ussi ka hai . kon hai jo uss kay huzoor uss ki ijazat kay baghair kissi ki sifarish ker-sakay-? woh saray bandon kay tamam aagay peechay kay halaat ko khoob janta hai , aur woh log uss kay ilm ki koi baat apney ilm kay daeray mein nahi laasaktay , siwaye uss baat kay jissay woh khud chahye . uss ki kursi ney saray aasmano aur zameen ko ghera huwa hai ; aur inn dono ki nigehbani say ussay zara bhi bojh nahi hota , aur woh bara aali maqam , sahab-e-azmat hai .

deen kay moamlay mein koi zabardasti nahi hai . hidayat ka raasta gumrahi say mumtaz ho ker wazeh hochuka . iss kay baad jo shaks taghoot ka inkar ker kay Allah per emaan ley aaye ga , uss ney aik mazboot kunda thaam liya jiss kay tootney ka koi imkan nahi . aur Allah khoob sunney wala , sabb kuch janney wala hai .

Allah emaan walon ka rakhwala hai ; woh unhen andheriyon say nikal ker roshni mein lata hai . aur jinn logon  ney kufr apna liya hai , unn kay rakhwalay woh shetan hain jo unhen roshni say nikal ker andheriyon mein ley jatay hain . woh sabb aag kay baasi hain ; woh hamesha ussi mein rahen gay .

kiya tum ney uss shaks ( kay haal ) per ghor kiya jiss ko Allah ney saltanat kiya dey di thi kay woh apney perwerdigar ( kay wajood hi ) kay baaray mein Ibrahim say behas kernay laga-? jab Ibrahim ney kaha kay :  mera perwerdigar woh hai jo zindagi bhi deta hai aur moat bhi  to woh kehney laga kay :  mein bhi zindagi deta hun aur moat deta hun .    Ibrahim ney kaha :  acha !
